description:
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying its mana cost.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
